Owner ruling 2026-08-29: a party that could not get a single kill is not worth recording. Coverage 90% of players across sampled battles. A party is NOT a comp: a large battle is a coalition of parties. Prevalence is not effectiveness. DISPLAY/EVIDENCE ONLY, never a scoring input.
